submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: independently drawn individual 2D game animation sprite, 05_celestial_musician_girl, cast/E/10 of 16 at 45ms/frame.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved character identity, purple-gold rigid long qin, costume and anatomical hand assignment. Image 2 is the EAST / screen-right idle reference and exact camera, proportions, scale and fixed ground position. Image 3 is the approved main hand-painted style and finish only; exclude all UI.
Primary request: ONE new full-body casting animation pose of the same celestial musician girl facing EAST / screen right. Immediate follow-through after the release. Torso inclines 8 degrees forward, right forearm travels a little farther down and outward beyond the near string edge, right fingers now more relaxed and separated. Right elbow begins lowering while left support keeps qin at 9 degrees above idle. Knees absorb the motion; the leading sleeve is at its widest delayed extension and ribbon ends continue trailing.
Fixed canvas: exactly 1024 x 1024 true transparent RGBA PNG, native individual frame at least 1024 x 1024, not a sheet. Fixed orthographic side camera matching the E idle image. Head/body size and proportions equal the corresponding 512px idle at 2x, without enlarging or stretching individual parts. Ground/root near x535,y934, soles near y934; ordinary upright crown top y126. Genuine torso bend may change head position but not its size. Never recenter or rescale around this frame's bounding box. Keep the entire crown, hair, ribbons, qin, sleeves, trousers and boots inside the canvas with margins. Both feet must remain anatomically coherent and readable.
Identity/style: preserve purple high bun and long straight hair; lotus gold crown, purple blossoms, pearl chains; large round violet eyes; ivory/lavender robes with light warm-gold embroidery; short rounded chibi limbs; green waist knot; lilac trousers; embroidered boots. Bright clean rounded plump Taoist chibi hand painting, crisp silhouettes, soft painted volume, refined cloth folds, natural translucent pale-lavender ribbons. Match the approved painting style and costume, not merely colors.
Anatomy/invariants: one rigid long flat qin of unchanged elongated silhouette, length, strings and decorations; NOT a round-bodied pipa or lute. Two arms and hands, two legs. Anatomical LEFT supports the upper qin and anatomical RIGHT plucks the strings, then follows through just outside the near string edge. Direction changes never exchange anatomical hands. This E view is independently drawn from its own reference, never mirrored from the other direction. Fingers cleanly separated, wrists connected naturally to forearms.
Avoid: extra qin or limbs, text/labels, grid or contact sheet, copied idle, mirrored pose, background, floor, cast shadow, baked checkerboard, opaque backdrop, magic projectiles, glow, energy rings, sparkles or spell particles. Render only body, facial expression, weapon and moving clothing on real transparent alpha.
